# Lumina Earth Minerals

> Bulk exporter of Himalayan salt and industrial minerals from Khewra, Pakistan, serving importers, distributors and manufacturers worldwide.

Lumina Earth Minerals supplies Himalayan salt, Bentonite, Limestone, Antimony, Nephrite Jade, White Quartz, Silica Sand and Copper in bulk to B2B buyers, with private-label and custom packaging options.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.luminaearthminerals.com/): Overview of Lumina Earth Minerals and its mineral export catalog.
- [Products](https://www.luminaearthminerals.com/products): Full export catalog of Himalayan salt and industrial minerals.
- [About](https://www.luminaearthminerals.com/about): Company background and sourcing regions.
- [Private Label](https://www.luminaearthminerals.com/private-label): Private-label Himalayan salt product program.
- [FAQ](https://www.luminaearthminerals.com/faq): Bulk-order and export questions answered.
- [Blog](https://www.luminaearthminerals.com/blog): Guides and sourcing insights on Himalayan salt and industrial minerals.
- [Contact](https://www.luminaearthminerals.com/contact): Contact details and quotation requests.
